req.title: Player payload includes squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall include the squadNumber field on every response body under /players/.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-032 requires that every response body under /players/ includes the squadNumber field. The primary endpoint under test is GET /players/{id}. We need: (1) a positive case confirming squadNumber is present and has the correct exact value for a known player, (2) a negative case confirming a 404 for a non-existent UUID (error pathway), (3) a boundary case using the first (squad 1) and last (squad 26) seeded players to confirm squadNumber appears at both extremes. Additional tests cover: exact value assertion to kill constant-mutation operators, the camelCase alias (squadNumber vs squad_number), and the 404 path to kill status-code mutations.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_exact_value
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 seeded players
Player with id=97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802 and squadNumber=1 exists
trace: R-PLAYER-032: squadNumber field must appear on every /players/ response body
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_exact_value():
    player_id = '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'squadNumber' in body
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body['id'] == player_id
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
